segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers generally report the mist absorbs well, hydrates without greasiness, and adds glow, though one notes it did not fix her texture and only mildly reduced acne redness.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including some with eczema, mostly describe good hydration and comfort over time, but two report stinging, redness, or an allergic-type reaction on first use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as balancing and helpful for acne-prone patches, with one calling it a holy grail for clearing painful under-skin bumps.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it calms redness, rosacea, or eczema and doesn't burn, while others report stinging, flushing, rash-like spots, or breakouts.
segments.mature: Only passing mention exists for mature skin, with no specific concrete effects described beyond general hydration comments.

concerns.aging: There is minimal specific commentary on aging; a couple of reviewers imply smoother, softer-looking skin over time but no one links it directly to fine lines or firmness.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe visible improvement in hydration, plumpness, and comfort, especially in winter or after sun exposure; one reviewer says it feels like plain water and does nothing for dryness.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with rosacea or general redness say it calms and reduces flushing, but others report the product itself triggered new redness, rash-like spots, or a hot, flushed reaction.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe reaching for it specifically when their skin barrier feels damaged and note noticeable improvement, with no barrier-related complaints reported.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports dramatic fading of dark spots and blemishes within days; this is an outlier and not echoed elsewhere.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report clearer skin, fewer cystic bumps, and reduced breakouts over weeks, while multiple others report new whiteheads, cystic acne, or worsened breakouts on the chin, neck, and nose.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers say it controls shine and absorbs without feeling greasy, with no reports of increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Missing or loose cap on delivery
Feels like plain water, not moisturizing

extraits.texte: Love all my byoma products so wanted to give this a try. Used as recommended on dry clean skin, shaking the bottle everytime. Letting it absorb into the skin and dry before applying any other products. Broke me out into painful cystic acne on my chin and neck really badly. Not sure what ingredient is causing this but I looked at the list and saw nothing out of the ordinary. Be careful if you have sensitive and acne prone skin, this may not be for you.

I have extremely dry skin so i've been looking for things to implement into my skin prep before makeup so I chose to pick this up after hearing good things about the brand, sad to say, it gave me an allergic reaction. I washed my face and sprayed it on, about 15 minutes passed when I felt my face getting flushed/hot. I checked in the mirror and a bunch of little red almost rash looking spots appeared. Now i'm usually red around my cheek area so I decided to wash it off and try again the next day but when I did, it was the same result. Red all over, in areas i'm usually not red. Additonally, the spray did leave a slight tacky feeling + the pump isnt the best, but those are things that I can get past, especially for the price point. I have eczema and dry to combo skin (depends on the weather, flare ups, etc.) so if you suffer from dryness/eczema, i'd be cautious! Didn't work for me but we're all different so it's worth a try :)

I bought this stuff and was super excited to have something to just spray on before I slap on my moisturizer and sunscreen and go. Unfortunately, I personally experienced breakouts from this product. I wouldn't fault it since I know I have sensitive skin, but there are plenty of products I've used on my skin that I haven't broken out from ... overall, I want to love it, and I almost wanna keep using it regardless of the breakouts, because it's so satisfying and fun to spray on, but I don't think I'd be doing myself any favors. But again, that might just be my skin, so I'd still rate the product well, as it feels nice, applies well, and did feel good on my skin before the breakouts. But then the breakouts were those painful deep under the skin ones, even on my neck too, bc I sprayed a bit there too. Too bad :(
for months ive been searching for something to help my combination acne prone skin and this was it! adding it into my routine has cleared my skin of all painful underskin bumps super grateful!

I have oily skin and a slight texture to it. I was looking for something to add to my simple skincare routine and bought this on a whim. I have noticed my skin feels so smooth and soft, less redness and feels so refreshed. I haven't notice any adverse reactions to my sensitive skin. I do notice a subtle strange smell, but for me in only when first sprayed and then goes away shortly after.

This will be my second time repurchasing this toner and I absolutely love it so much. I have very very dry skin and eczema on my face. This is the first product that keeps me hydrated during the day and does not burn my sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: always a repurchase for my wife and I
extraits.texte: My wife and I absolutely love this product. I definitely find myself reaching for this mist whenever my skin barrier feels like it's been damaged. it's great if you need a toner just to kind of get the job done but not do anything complicated. I have sensitive dry skin and my wife has combination and we both appreciate it so much
